firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently dug a planting bed in their own garden goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: That player receives the Starting player token. After Income, they take the first Action, followed by the other players clockwise.
Initial Dwelling placement and Bonus-card selection have their own setup orders. They do not replace the token holder as the first player in the Action phase.
In later rounds, the first player to pass becomes the next round’s starting player.
